what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in Uganda, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10692 Ethiopian refugees in Uganda, 6.5% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan and Kenya host the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government and Amhara territory with Fano from 2023 to 2025, at war level, and over Oromiya territory with the OLA from 2019 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall in the same years as these conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1976 at 70 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 10718, at the end of 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Uganda.
These are year-end totals for Uganda only, reported to UNHCR.
